lines: The wind agreed to stop. You waited for it.
The coast is still roaring. If the Keep asks, say: you waited for the wind.
If you want to see Shadowwind—learn to wait first. The instant the wind stops is the true one.
Don't chase afterimages. Wait for the beat-pause, then shoot. Titles can't catch the wind.
The woods know the beat-pause, not titles. Walking slow is good.
